visual_action: A split-screen video shows a congressional or committee hearing. On the left, Senator Jon Ossoff is speaking at a microphone. On the right, another man in a suit listens and occasionally responds. The setting is a formal hearing room.

cast.name: Jon Ossoff
cast.evidence: He is identified by face recognition and by the on-screen text "Senator Ossoff". He is the person speaking and asking questions on the left side of the screen. A nameplate in front of him appears to incorrectly read "MR. KELLY".

cast.name: unnamed Director of National Intelligence nominee (addressed as Mr. Clayton)
cast.evidence: He is the man on the right being questioned. The on-screen text identifies him as "Trump's Director of National Intelligence pick". Senator Ossoff addresses him as "Mr. Clayton" at 0:02.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text refers to "Trump's Director of National Intelligence pick". Senator Ossoff also refers to him indirectly as "the president's delusions".

on_screen_text.text: Senator Ossoff LAYS into Trump's Director of National Intelligence pick for denying the results of the 2020 election 🔥

spoken_summary: Senator Jon Ossoff repeatedly presses a nominee for Director of National Intelligence to state who won the 2020 presidential election. The nominee evades the question, saying he has already answered it. Ossoff argues that the nominee's refusal to answer a simple, factual question while seeking to lead the intelligence community is "humiliating" and an indulgence of "the president's delusions."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of spoken dialogue from the hearing, with no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video uses a static split-screen format. The editing consists of adding large, yellow text overlays that appear in sync with the spoken dialogue.
central_claim: A Trump appointee for Director of National Intelligence is unfit for office because he refuses to acknowledge the factual results of the 2020 election.
intended_effect: To portray Trump's nominee as dishonest and unqualified, and to present Senator Ossoff as a defender of truth and accountability.
uncertainty_flags: The identity of the nominee being questioned is unclear; he is called "Mr. Clayton" by Ossoff, but the top caption identifies him as Trump's pick for Director of National Intelligence.
A nameplate in front of Senator Ossoff incorrectly says "MR. KELLY".
